en: Anyhow, here's a little somethin' as a token of thanks.
You got <Color:8>Zero Jewel<Color:Default>.
Hope to see ya at Kushikatsu Daruma, Akiyama-san!
You got 1,300 experience points.
Gimme a break, gramps! Outta my way!

First pick up that cigarette ya tossed! This ain't a garbage
dump! Everyone uses this street!

Stupid old fuck! The street's full of litter already! Why
you gotta pick on me!?

Oh, so if the street's already dirty, it's okay? How'd you
like it if I threw my garbage away at your house?
Hey, the fuck's goin' on over here!?
Ah, there ya are! This old goat won't leave me alone!

Well, I was just tellin' him not to throw his cigarette
butts into the street.

Ain't so high and mighty now, are ya? One look at my boy
here's got ya pissin' your pants!
I just...

Hey, gramps, how 'bout an apology? Get down on the street
and grovel a little. C'mon, hurry up!
You can't just go around disrespectin' people, old man.

But if ya bow down to us, all will be forgiven. You have my
word. Just kneel down and don't make a fuss.
You can't...

Just show us you learned your lesson, and we won't have to
break your legs. You got that?

Hmph. What kinda man do you fools take me for!? If you think
for one second I'm gonna bow down to you, then you're even
dumber than you look!

Ain't nothin' for me to apologize about. You won't catch me
kneelin' down to the likes of you. You wanna fight, I'm more
than willing!

No point in bein' bullheaded, gramps. You wanna go to the
hospital over a cigarette butt?

Zip it! You're the one causin' trouble here! I'll teach you
blockheads a lesson!

Very funny, gramps. You spit in our faces, so you oughta
know there ain't no way we're backin' down now.
Might be a good idea, if you ask me.

The two of you picking on this old timer? You'd never live
that one down.
What? You sure you wanna take that attitude with us?
I'll tell you what, you walk away, and I'll back down, too.

But if you lay a finger on this guy, you'll have to deal
with me.

Just a passerby. It was nice to hear someone sticking up for
himself for a change.
Heh. Say, thanks!

You talk a big game, but you really oughta think of the
consequences before mouthin' off. Your life just got a whole
lot shorter.

We'd never hear the end of it if we just let this go. Got no
choice but to spill some blood!

Uh-oh! Now ya really made him mad! Hahaha, too bad! That'll
teach ya to mess with us!

Oh, hi, Akiyama-san! I was getting tired of waiting. Did you
find out anything?

Hold on, Saida-san. That watch you're wearing... It's pretty
high-end, isn't it? Probably goes for about a million yen?

Good eye! A watch plays an important role in defining a
man's status. That's why I chose this piece here. Highly
respected brand, you know.
That's just it, Saida-san.
Huh? What's just it?

That watch. There's no questioning its brand power. And it's
obviously a respectable piece of jewelry.
Heheh, I don't doubt it. Not one bit.

But at the same time, it also happens to be a very standard
choice. As far as expressing one's own fashion sense goes,
it's hardly unique.
Some might even say it's... unhip.
Oh no...

Your fashion sense has no sense of freedom. It's just too
perfect.

Wealthy or not, not many women will be drawn to a man who
plays things so by the book.
Fine, then. What kind of watch do you suggest I wear?

How about this? We'll go to a brand shop now and check out
some watches.
We can continue this conversation there.
Okay, let's do that!
Oh, Akiyama-san! Learn anything?
No. Nothing useful yet.
Oh... You're my only hope. I'm counting on you!
Good grief...

Please, would you ask Miyu-chan just what exactly makes me
so unhip?

I'm so ashamed by this. If I don't fix it, I won't be able
to go to your club ever again.

(Damn. What to do? He's a loyal customer and a big spender.
Turning him down would be bad for business.)
All right, sure. I'll have a chat with Miyu.
You will? Thank you!

Got to hand it to you on your negotiating skills. How could I
turn down a regular when they're threatening not to return?
Ahaha, sorry...
I'll pop over to the club. Mind waiting here?

(Oh boy, another fine mess. Miyu should still be at Elise.
I'd better talk to her.)

I'm terribly sorry, but I can't give preferential treatment
to a specific client like that. You understand, don't you?

Oh, but... that means I won't be able to visit your club
anymore. You're telling me to take my business elsewhere.
Damn it! What about me is unhip?
(Hm? I know that guy...)
(That's right. That's Saida-san. He's a regular at Elise.)
Saida-san.

Hm? Well, if it isn't Elise's owner himself. Hello,
Akiyama-san. Imagine running into you here.
Is there a problem?
It's not so much a problem, but...
Akiyama-san, I need you to be honest with me.
Am I really that unhip?
I'm sorry?
Well, am I?
Uh... Well...
I'd say so, yeah.
So, I really am unhip. Why is that?

It's not exactly something I can pinpoint, but... There's
just something a little off, I think.
Well, that doesn't help me! What am I supposed to do?
Hold on, hold on. What brought this up?

I wouldn't say that. On the contrary, I'd say you're
reasonably with it.

That's what I thought, too. I've always thought that. So now
I'm not sure what to do.
What happened, exactly?

Well, you know how our firm regularly uses your club to
entertain clients?
Yes, of course. And we do appreciate your patronage.

I have a confession⑬I've fallen for one of your hostesses.
It's Miyu-chan...
Miyu? Heh...

I wanted to get to know her better, so I built up some
courage and asked her out.
She shot me down. "You're just not hip enough for me," she said.
I see. So that's what has you down.

I don't mean to toot my own horn here, but I'm a successful
businessman with a top-name company. I have a certain level
of confidence in myself.

Being close to forty, I know I'm a bit old, but I wouldn't
say I've lost my looks. The suit I'm wearing is the latest
in today's fashion, too.

True. People in the know would recognize you to be very
well-off.

If she turned me down because she doesn't like me as a
person, well, that wouldn't be great either. But I could at least come to terms with that.
But to say I'm not hip enough... I just don't understand it.
Did Miyu say anything else about that?

I... Actually, I was so stunned by her rejection, I stumbled
out of the club without probing any deeper. Pathetic, I
know.
I see...

Akiyama-san, please, can you ask Miyu-chan just why she
thinks I'm so unhip?

That's honestly out of my hands... If you have a complaint
about our service quality, I'm all ears. But if it's a
private matter...

Please! I'm so ashamed by this. If I don't fix it, I won't
be able to go to your club ever again.
Here. You might want to read this.
Mature men with a dash of bad boy...
I get it now. Women like this kind of thing!

That's exactly it. What you were missing was that dash of
wickedness.
You mean that thing about "roguish appeal"?

That's it. Of course, that doesn't mean you should actually
be wicked or evil or anything.

But don't you think there are times when a guy can afford to
show off his "bad side" a little?

On a logical level, women seek stability, but on an
instinctual level, they're often attracted to danger. Lots
of women seek a little more than just honesty and decency.
The dangerous side of men...
I get it now!

Thanks for everything, Akiyama-san! I'm going to ask Miyu
out again!
Excellent. I'm sure you'll succeed this time.

(That should do it. I better swing by Elise later and see
how it all turns out.)
Miyu, do you have a minute?
Oh, hi, boss. For you, always. What do you need?
Saida-san stopped by earlier, right?
Yes, he did. What about it?

Well, no sense beating around the bush⑬what made you turn
him down?

Are you kidding? He's so not hip. He's a wonderful customer,
sure, but to be seen in public together, he's just so...
Unhip. Right.

You say that, but is that really true? Saida-san wears the
latest fashions from all the top brands. He's far better
dressed than most guys, wouldn't you say?

Not you too, boss. You don't get it either. That's exactly
what makes him so unhip!

That man's fashion sense is... how do I put it? It's like
he's a mannequin. So neat, and tidy, and boooring.

Well, now that you mention it, he does wear his collar
buttoned to the top. I guess he might come across as kind of
stuffy.

He's so prim and proper even when he's drinking here. A date
would be just so tedious.

A serious company man married to his job isn't my idea of
fun. I prefer a man who knows how to cut loose and enjoy
himself.
Okay, so would dressing a little more like me help?
In a cheesy suit like that?
Huh...?
You only need a touch of playfulness.
And a touch would be how much?

Come on, boss, instead of counting on me to give you all the
answers, why don't you do some research on your own?
Okay, okay, fine.

(Studying up on fashion? Maybe there's a good magazine at
one of the convenience stores.)

Hmm... The watch I'm wearing appears to be the most
expensive one on the market.

Saida-san, comparing price tags won't make you more
fashionable. You need to consider the design.
Design?
Hey! Your watch... That's a pretty unique design!
Oh, you noticed. It's a GaGa Milano.
A GaGa Milano? Are those famous?

Yes. It's a brand that's becoming increasingly popular,
especially among pro athletes and entertainers.

The watch face's design is striking, isn't it? I think it'd
make a pretty big statement if it was worn alongside some
formal business attire.

That's true. If I'm wearing a suit that's formal and
reserved, a flashy watch is sure to catch an eye or two!

Think about it this way: even if you're great at your job,
you shouldn't have to lose your sense of fun.

Let me ask you⑬do you ever find people who are super
committed to their jobs to be a little too much so? As if they have no time for anything but their job?

Right, I get it now. What I lacked was a sense of fun. I was
too much of a stuffed shirt.
I'll buy this watch and try to show my fun side.

I can't believe I'm wearing something this flashy. I've worn
clothes so conservatively all my life⑬I feel like a new
man!

Great. Now that you're feeling it, why don't you try asking
Miyu out again?
Huh? But I...

Well, you see, you know how I always use your club to
entertain clients?

I've never been there in my private time. I could never work
up the courage to go on my own.

Huh? What are you talking about? It's no different than when
you go on business.

Business and private situations are completely different,
though. Miyu would just think of me as some pervy old man
if I were to come in by myself.
(No wonder the guy's no hit with the ladies.)

(Leon claimed that women go for mature men with a little bit
of a bad side. I guess they're not too far off the mark.)
Uh, Saida-san.
You're missing something.
Come with me, and I'll show you.
Saida-san. Looks like things went well.

Yes, they did! I'm going on my dream date with Miyu-chan
after her shift, and it's all thanks to your advice!
Oh no, I just passed on what I read in Leon.

I'm going on a date with a hostess⑬that makes me feel a
little like a bad boy.
Heh, sounds like you gained a lot of confidence.

Consider me your customer for life. This is hardly adequate,
but please take it.
You got a <Color:8>Durable Cloth<Color:Default>.
Whoops, it's almost time. I'll be going now!

(Didn't expect things to work out so well. Guess ladies
really do like the older bad boys, after all.)
Huh? You want something?
(He looks pretty down on somethin'... Maybe I oughta hear his story?)
Say, what's makin' ya drink like that?
What's it to you? Every man needs a drink now and then.
There's a proper way to drink. And it ain't no way to lift your spirits.
What happened? You really want to know?
Nothing happened. I'm just not much use anymore. So what else is there for me to do but drink?
What, ya lose your job or somethin'?
But I might as well have. A perp I'd been chasing for years suddenly went poof.
Perp? Are you a detective?
That I am. Detective Araseki of the Tsukimino Police Department, at your service.
(Aw, shit.)
What do you look so surprised for? A detective can't enjoy a drink on his own time?
Uh, no, 'course you can.
(Guess he hasn't cottoned onto me bein' a wanted man. No surprise considerin' how wasted he is.)
